video_title: Fabolous Responds To 50 Cent’s Jay-Z Comments & Biggie’s Interest In Signing Him

quotes.speaker: Fabolous
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Marbury's influence on Fabolous's career and development
quotes.excerpt: There is no better motivation or influence than seeing it and I saw it from childhood.

text_blocks.speaker: Fabolous
text_blocks.text: I want to say Stephon Marbury because one thing about Stephon is I got to see it. There is no better motivation or influence than seeing it and I saw it from childhood. In my projects, Stephon Marbury was already this talked about point guard in the city. He had a cousin who lived in my projects, so one time he came over and played in the tournament. He was a real polished player even back then.

text_blocks.speaker: Fabolous
text_blocks.text: When you are playing in Rucker, it is just a different temperature, a different tempo. I do not know if they were keeping him away from that tempo, but I remember after that he did not really come back. But he was from the projects, so I think him touching other things like my projects was just to get him in tune to different tempos when you are playing ball.

quotes.speaker: Fabolous
quotes.summary_phrase: Spike Lee's impact on showcasing Brooklyn neighborhoods in film
quotes.excerpt: Spike Lee on the movie side, he would shoot movies in Brooklyn and we would get to see.
quotes.quote: Another one I would say is Spike Lee because Spike Lee on the movie side, he would shoot movies in Brooklyn and we would get to see our neighborhoods in movies. We would get to see where he is doing Do the Right Thing. I really know those blocks and I really know just the whole area and the whole feeling that is going on in the movies. In Do the Right Thing, there were so many things that connected just because it was where you were from and I think he took Brooklyn and put it on the world to see.

quotes.speaker: Fabolous
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Tyson's impact as an unapologetic figure from Brooklyn
quotes.excerpt: Mike Tyson is a special person, he is one of a kind.
quotes.quote: I would say Mike Tyson because he is another person that I could see where he came from. Mike Tyson is a special person, he is one of a kind. You can see what he and he is also unapologetically him through all of these decades of who is going to do something to him, who is going to say something to him. You still do not want a punch by Mike. He might be 60, but I still, it is going to hurt.

quotes.speaker: Fabolous
quotes.summary_phrase: Jay-Z's cultural influence and business acumen as a rapper
quotes.excerpt: Jay-Z may not have been selling 10 million like DMX, Nelly, Eminem, but the influence on the culture.
quotes.quote: In late 90s, early 2000s, Jay-Z may not have been selling 10 million like DMX, Nelly, Eminem, but the influence on the culture along with his music, setting trends. Jay-Z had us wearing button ups and he was setting the trends. So in that sense, domination musically, I do not know about that, but as an artist overall, he dominated.

quotes.speaker: Fabolous
quotes.summary_phrase: Jay-Z's unique status as a businessman in the rap industry
quotes.excerpt: Jay-Z is the most dominant as far as being a businessman as a rapper.
quotes.quote: Jay-Z is the most dominant as far as being a businessman as a rapper. Before that, there were no businessmen in rap. The business aspect that 50 is able to even launch off is from Jay-Z doing that years before. Jay-Z did not come into having a deal. He had to literally be the CEO and the rapper to launch his own career. He did not have a record deal until he made it to where now he is the business, he is the brand.
